_comment: Binding metadata for the hooks in this directory. A hook script cannot
declare its own event, so scripts/install-hooks.py reads it from here.
Each entry: the script's filename, the harness event it binds to, an
optional tool matcher, an optional `if` permission-rule prefilter (which
keeps the hook from spawning on every unrelated call), and a one-line
reason naming the rule it enforces.

hooks.why: CLAUDE.md 'Timestamp recaps in local time' -- supplies the real local time each turn, because a fabricated timestamp is indistinguishable from a remembered one.
Blocks mutating repo-scoped gh commands lacking -R, so a write never silently targets whatever repo the cwd happens to be.
report-mistakes-proactively 'Filing is not gated on approval' -- blocks a reply that offers to file or record instead of doing it.
